newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Backus group to decide on merger Oct 25.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Backus group to decide on merger Oct 25.

text.p: Shareholders of the four breweries in Peru's Backus group will meet October 25 to decide on a possible merger plan, according to stock exchange and company sources.

The proposed new company, Cervecerias Peruanas Backus y Johnston, would include local stock market blue chips Cerveceria Backus y Johnston and Compania Nacional de Cerveza, and the smaller breweries Sociedad Cervecera de Trujillo SA and Cerveceria del Norte.
If approved by shareholders, the merger would take place on December 30, the sources said.
The four breweries have total annual sales of $365.7 million.
